_status: PARTIAL -- alg:none and weak_secret only (docs/DECISIONS.md item 95). RS256->HS256 confusion deliberately NOT included: it requires discovering the target's RSA public key (JWKS-endpoint parsing) to use as the forged token's HMAC secret -- infrastructure this project doesn't have yet, and unlike weak-secret guessing there is no comparable curated list of commonly-reused RSA public keys to draw from instead. See jwt_scanner.py module docstring. Schema: id, technique ('alg_none' | 'weak_secret'), secret (weak_secret entries only -- the literal HMAC secret guessed). The weak_secret wordlist includes jwt.io's own debugger-page default placeholder ('your-256-bit-secret'), well-documented as a common real-world finding when developers copy a jwt.io example into production without changing it.
